req.title: Delete only by author
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 403 Forbidden when a user attempts to delete a post they did not author.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that only the author of a post should be able to delete it, and any other user should receive a 403 Forbidden response. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_post_by_author
preconditions: User A is logged in and has authored a post.
actions: User A attempts to delete their own post.
expected: HTTP 302 response is returned, redirecting to the index.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login user A
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'userA', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'userA', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post by user A
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Post by A', 'body': 'Content'})

# Attempt to delete the post by the author
r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_delete_post_by_non_author
preconditions: User A is logged in and has authored a post.
User B is logged in and is not the author of the post.
actions: User B attempts to delete User A's post.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login user A
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'userA', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'userA', 'password': 'pass'})

# Create a post by user A
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Post by A', 'body': 'Content'})

# Register and login user B
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'userB', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'userB', 'password': 'pass'})

# Attempt to delete the post by non-author
r = client.post('/1/delete')
assert r.status_code == 403

tests.name: test_delete_post_boundary_case
preconditions: User A is logged in and has authored a post.
User A attempts to delete a non-existent post.
actions: User A attempts to delete a post with an ID that does not exist.
expected: HTTP 404 Not Found response is returned.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login user A
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'userA', 'password': 'pass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'userA', 'password': 'pass'})

# Attempt to delete a non-existent post
r = client.post('/999/delete')
assert r.status_code == 404
